# Code blocks

Tables in `md` code blocks are formatted as Markdown:

```md
| a | bbbbbb |
|---|---|
| cccccc | d |
```

Other code blocks are kept or formatted by their own language:

```text
| a | bbbbbb |
|---|---|
```

```json
{"name":"prettier-plugin-minimal-diff","keywords":["prettier","plugin","markdown","table"]}
```
